project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack marketplace web application
test_framework: Jest with React Testing Library for components, integration tests for API routes
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to check TypeScript compilation and Next.js build. 2. Run npm test to execute test suite. 3. Verify all source files have proper TypeScript types.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated from schema via npx prisma generate. Database migrations via npx prisma migrate dev.
setup_instructions: 1. npm install (requires network). 2. Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in values. 3. npx prisma generate. 4. npx prisma migrate dev. 5. npm run dev.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install npm packages from public registries. All source code will be created but npm install cannot run. TypeScript compiler (tsc) is available globally. Focus on creating complete, well-structured source code ready for deployment once dependencies are installed.
contribution_requirements: Standard Next.js App Router conventions. All code in TypeScript. Prisma for database. Stripe Connect for payments. NextAuth.js for auth. Tailwind CSS for styling.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with src/app directory structure, server components by default, client components marked with 'use client', API routes in app/api/, Prisma schema in prisma/schema.prisma, shared types in src/types/, utility functions in src/lib/
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js pages and API routes | src/components/ - Reusable UI components | src/lib/ - Utility functions and service logic | src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions | prisma/ - Database schema and migrations | public/ - Static assets
